name: companion_pending
description: Lists the user's cards in this companion: reminders with their time, and check cards with the pending items of each topic (a project or a subject), plus what was ticked today, with the current date and time first. Use it when the user asks what they have pending, what is left for today, what they have to do on a project, or what reminders they have, and before companion_card with done true, to get the id of the item or reminder. It does not show coding sessions (that is companion_sessions). Returns one line per reminder or item: id | kind [topic] | time or state | text.

topic.description: Only this topic: a watched project's folder name or a subject, as companion_pending shows it in brackets (e.g. tanka). Leave it out for all.
